message: Malay muat turun / muat naik: write Unduh / Unggah (mengunduh, mengunggah), D-05 and D-07.
Malay word (D-07 ban list): write file, Pengaturan, browser, perangkat, perangkat lunak, basis data, laptop, kantor, karena, Klik, dapat, jika or saat, and -itas for -iti (identitas, prioritas).
Over-formal official coinage (study 3(b)): write Kesalahan / Error, browser, default, preset, mouse, tautan, untai or thread; (bawaan) may gloss default once in help.
Vendor form that D-05 did not choose: write Pengaturan, Atur ulang (diatur ulang), Lanjutan, Unduh, Unggah.
The glossary term is file (D-05); berkas appears at most once, as a help gloss "(berkas)".

Not the glossary form (study T1, D-05): write sekuens, sirkular, linear, untai, Kesalahan / Error, riwayat, track, penjajaran. Some are attested variants (sekuen, penyejajaran, pensejajaran), not misspellings; the catalog keeps one form.
Write Anda with a capital A, also inside a sentence (D-07).
Informal register: use the impersonal imperative, or Anda where a person is needed (D-07).
The prepositions di and ke stand apart from the place word: di atas, di dalam, di luar, ke bawah, ke kiri.
The passive prefix di- is written together with its verb: dihapus, disimpan, diterapkan, diatur ulang.
Wrong meN- form: an initial s, p, k or t of the base drops (menyimpan, memilih, mengonversi, menampilkan, menerapkan).
Do not attach an Indonesian affix to an English word with a hyphen (di-reset, meng-upload): use the Indonesian verb (diatur ulang, mengunggah).
A short value that starts with a nominalized command: a button or menu command takes the base verb (Simpan sesi, not Penyimpanan sesi), study 3(c).
A meN- form without … or a period: a progress text ends with one … (Menyimpan sesi…); a button takes the base verb (Simpan).
Write one … (U+2026) with no space before it, never three periods (STYLE 1.2).
Decimal comma: the app keeps the English decimal point (0.65, 1.5 kb), D-04.
Thousands grouped with a period (1.000) read as Indonesian; keep the English comma grouping (1,000 bp), D-04.
bp, kb and Mb stay as written (STYLE 1.2); never pb, kpb or Mpb.
Use straight double quotes "…" around a quoted name or UI word (D-07); never curly quotes or guillemets.
Letter or punctuation outside ASCII: Indonesian text uses ASCII letters only (kafe, not café); text from another catalog may have leaked in.
Character outside ASCII and the expected symbols (… · → ← × ′ – − — ≈ ≥ ≤ ° ± µ): check it; no NBSP and no full-width punctuation.
Title Case label: use sentence case (Simpan sesi, not Simpan Sesi), D-07.
English plural of a kept or loan word: Indonesian nouns do not inflect ({count} record, Hit maksimum, preset track).
No plural reduplication after a count: {count} fitur, not {count} fitur-fitur.
Write Tidak dapat + verb and Gagal + verb (Gagal memuat sesi), and the bare imperative without Silakan (Pilih record.), study 3(c).
KBBI writes tumpang tindih as two words without a hyphen (r1 term audit).
Retired term (r1 term audit): write reverse complement, locus tag, garis skala, query / subject (BLAST roles), ke arah upstream / downstream.
